listing.name: Doom 3 (classic) (DUDE — Doom 3 Unified Development Engine)
listing.summary: Use the official DUDE Windows player with your own classic Doom 3 files. First Play can copy an existing dhewm3 profile; preserve both profiles before continuing.

steps.title: Prepare your original game
steps.instruction: Before Play, copy base/pak000.pk4 through base/pak008.pk4 from your own classic Doom 3 installation patched to 1.3.1 into base beside dude.exe. Keep the originals separately. BFG Edition is a different product. Portcove does not verify original-game identity. Keep the complete official Windows player package and all its own DLLs and resources together; do not overwrite them with old engine files. Optional baked-AO packages and custom mods use their own setup instructions and are outside this managed route. Check upstream renderer and hardware requirements for your selected mode; this fork does not inherit dhewm3 qualification.

steps.title: Review first-launch profile copying
steps.instruction: Windows normally stores saves and settings under the actual Documents/My Games/dude profile, with base/d3xp scopes. Explicit fs_savepath or mod paths can redirect writes. Preserve the actual profile, originals and creating runtime. Linux uses its own upstream location; no cross-engine or mod save compatibility is inferred. Before first Play, preserve both the existing Documents/My Games/dhewm3 profile and its creating runtime as well as any dude profile. If the dude profile is missing, this upstream Windows build silently copies the existing dhewm3 tree into it. A private original/runtime copy does not isolate that profile behavior. The game copies that profile without moving the original. Portcove does not manage the copied profile, and save compatibility has not been confirmed. Decide whether to allow this before choosing Play.

steps.title: Keep an existing prepared copy
steps.instruction: Keep the complete official Windows player package and its DLL/resources together. Register dude.exe in its runtime folder. Point to the folder containing base with three separate argument lines: +set, fs_basepath, then the absolute data-root path. Optional baked-AO downloads are separate from the player. Check the upstream renderer and hardware requirements for your chosen mode; dhewm3 test results do not apply to this fork. This is an external registration: you and upstream own its runtime replacement and all files. Removing its registration preserves those files. It does not migrate or adopt the copy into a managed installation.

warnings: First Play can copy an existing dhewm3 profile into a missing dude profile. Preserve both and decide before continuing.
